title: Cost, Budgets and Scaling to Many Domains
brief: Design an agent portfolio for an asset manager, or for your own firm's shape:
4-6 agents with audience, objects and owner, the shared metric-view foundation
underneath them, and a budget plan with thresholds and blocking decisions.
Name at least one metric that must be defined once and shared. Then say which agent
would do the most damage by redefining it locally, and what that damage looks like
when it reaches a client report.
review: Every agent has one audience and one topic, not a department's whole remit.
At least one metric is identified as shared, with a named owner.
The budget blocks service principals before it blocks people.
The plan says what happens at the threshold, not just what the threshold is.
